# NNNN — Title in a few words

- Status: proposed
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Issue: #N (Spec version and owner answers it came from, when there is one)

Optional parts, kept only when they apply:
- a `- Supersedes: ADR NNNN (what part)` line, when this record replaces an
  older decision or part of one (as 0030 does);
- a `- Renamed: …` line, when what the record names is later renamed (as
  0029 notes);
- an `## Alternatives` section after Consequences, when rejected options are
  worth keeping (as 0030 does).
Delete this paragraph and any part that does not apply.

## Context

What is true today, what changed, and why the current shape hurts.
Name the Issue the decision came from.

## Decision

Numbered list of what is decided. Each item says what changes and where
(file, module, or doc). Nothing here describes how the work is sequenced;
that lives on the Issue plan.

1. First decided thing.
2. Second decided thing.

## Consequences

What follows from the decision: what becomes possible, what is removed or
superseded, and what later work must respect. When this record supersedes
an older one, name it here; the older file stays, never deleted, and its
Status line points forward.
